j2_primary_markers: all eligible shared markers, all ordered directions
j2_resource_directions: first registered dataset to last registered dataset, all eligible shared markers

bootstrap.identity: registered global dataset::patient identity; common patients receive identical exponential weights across methods, directions, markers, seeds and tasks
bootstrap.scope: conditional on frozen models/splits; unit-descriptive directions have no patient CI

formal_scope: finite grid; no gating; no target-performance screening
